snippet.title: SILENT HILL: Townfall | Inside Screen Burn Part 2 (with subtitles) | KONAMI
snippet.description:
The behind-the-scenes look continues.
In Part 2, we return to Screen Burn’s studio in Glasgow  and tour inspirational locations in Scotland. The team unveils further insight into the development environment and creative process behind SILENT HILL: Townfall, as featured in SILENT HILL Transmission.
